changelog:
Initial release of the "tailor-resume" skill.

- Tailors and polishes an existing Google Docs resume for a specific job based on direct recruiter feedback or an official role description.
- Preserves strict truthfulness: never invents or inflates qualifications, metrics, or outcomes.
- Requires both an editable Google Docs resume link and a direct source of role direction (job description or recruiter feedback).
- Surfaces unsupported gaps honestly and requests user confirmation before adding new or ambiguous claims.
- Prioritizes clarity, evidence-backed edits, and clear communication of any remaining mismatches.
summary: Tailor and polish an existing resume in Google Docs for a particular job without inventing qualifications, experience, metrics, or outcomes. Use when the user provides an editable GDocs resume link plus either direct recruiter feedback for the hiring role or a direct link to the role description
